Container.Name: RISTWatch
Container.Overview: Self-hosted RIST ingest monitoring and management appliance. Default ports are isolated from an existing MooRIST deployment.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent RISTWatch configuration, logs, and database.

Config.Name: Test RIST
Config.Description: Development RIST listener. Do not reuse the production MooRIST port while both systems are installed.

Config.Name: RIST Enabled
Config.Description: Start the real ristreceiver listener on the Test RIST port.

Config.Name: RIST Username
Config.Description: RIST SRP username. Stored as a Docker environment variable.

Config.Name: RIST Password
Config.Description: RIST SRP password. Stored as a masked Docker environment variable.
